title: Add data quality monitoring for unit-econ datasets (freshness/completeness) + Slack alert wiring
creator: Logan Wright
description:
Context
The unit economics dashboard will be used as a source-of-truth for finance + product decisions, so we need basic dataset health monitoring with clear alert routing. This ticket covers freshness + completeness checks for the curated unit-econ datasets and wiring alerts to #eng-sre and #eng-platform.

In scope
- Freshness monitoring: detect late/missing daily partitions for unit-econ aggregate tables and semantic views used by the Console backend.
- Completeness monitoring: detect unexpected drops in token volume / request volume vs trailing baseline (to catch ingestion gaps, mapping errors, or pipeline failures).
- Wire alerts to Slack channels:
  - #eng-platform (owner for telemetry/analytics pipelines)
  - #eng-sre (visibility + escalation; SRE oncall should be aware of dashboard-impacting data issues)
- Document runbook pointers in the alert annotations (what to check, where to backfill, who owns what).

Out of scope (explicitly)
- Reconciliation variance alerts vs billing (tracked in ENG-2914).
- Access control / RBAC for restricted slices (tracked separately).

Datasets / surfaces to monitor (MVP)
- analytics.unit_econ_daily (daily blended $/1M output tokens by model/region/tier)
- analytics.unit_econ_daily_cache (cache metrics + estimated savings attribution, if present)
- semantic.unit_econ_* views that power the dashboard API

Proposed checks (initial thresholds; can tighten after baseline week)
1) Freshness
- Check: latest_partition_date >= (current_date - 1 day) AND latest_partition_loaded_at within 6 hours of expected schedule.
- Expected schedule: daily partition for D-1 complete by 09:00 UTC.
- Alerting:
  - Warning: freshness lag > 6h past expected schedule (Slack only)
  - Critical: missing D-1 partition by 18:00 UTC OR lag > 24h (Slack + page Platform oncall)

2) Completeness
- Check: for each (region, tier) aggregate, output_tokens and request_count should be within an acceptable band vs 7-day trailing median.
- Alerting:
  - Warning: drop > 20% vs median in a major slice (total, top regions)
  - Critical: drop > 40% in total OR drop > 60% for any single major region

Alert routing
- Slack: #eng-platform, #eng-sre
- Paging: Platform oncall only for Critical (SRE should not get paged for data issues; they get Slack + can assist).

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Dashboarding exists for dataset health (freshness + completeness time series and most recent status)
- [x] Alerts fire to #eng-platform and #eng-sre with:
  - dataset name
  - severity
  - current lag / completeness deviation
  - link(s) to dashboards + relevant logs
  - runbook pointer (backfill + mitigation)
- [x] Alerts have basic dedupe/silencing behavior (don’t spam every 5 minutes for the same missing partition)
- [x] Ownership is clear in alert annotations (Platform primary, SRE FYI)

Implementation notes
- Prefer warehouse-driven checks (simple SQL) producing a small status table (e.g., analytics.data_quality_unit_econ_daily) that Grafana/alert rules can query.
- Completeness baseline should be computed with guardrails for day-of-week effects; ok to start with 7-day trailing median and refine later.
- Make sure region/tier mapping issues don’t cause cardinality explosions in alert labels (alert labels should be: dataset, severity, slice_group=total|major_region|major_tier).

Links
- SLO/thresholds draft: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/unit-econ-metrics-data-quality-slo.json
- Dashboard initiative epic: PM-482
- Related work: ENG-2910 (dataset), ENG-2914 (reconciliation), ENG-2918 (backfill)
comments: 2025-01-29 (Aisha Bello): Drafted initial freshness SLO proposal: D-1 partitions ready by 09:00 UTC; warn at 6h lag, critical at 24h. Will align with Allison on alert routing (Slack vs page).

2025-01-30 (Allison Grant): +1 on not paging SRE for data issues. Please page Platform oncall for critical only; SRE gets Slack + can help with incident coordination if dashboard impacts exec/finance reviews.

2025-02-03 (Caleb Johnson): For completeness, I’d recommend starting with total + top regions only. Per-model completeness gets noisy and high-cardinality. We can expand once we have stable baselines.
2025-02-05 (Logan Wright): Agree on limiting alert labels. Let’s do slice_group=total and major_region only for MVP. We can add tier-only breakdown later if we find it catches issues sooner.

2025-02-10 (Aisha Bello): Implemented SQL checks producing analytics.data_quality_unit_econ_status (one row per dataset + slice_group + date). Added annotations with runbook pointers. Working with Allison to wire rules into observability-pack and Slack channels.

2025-02-13 (Allison Grant): Reviewed alert text. Please include: (1) expected partition date, (2) most recent loaded_at, (3) quick link to runbook for backfill + known mitigation (exclude late partitions).
2025-02-17 (Aisha Bello): Addressed feedback: alert now includes expected_partition, latest_partition, lag_hours, and Grafana panel link. Added basic dedupe (group_by dataset + slice_group).
2025-02-18 (Logan Wright): Marking done once observability-pack change is merged + alerts verified in #eng-platform. Please keep an eye on noise over the first week and adjust thresholds if needed.
